replication.target_description: University of Edinburgh replication of Elliot et al. Experiment 3, OSF post-completion registration dqv9y, red versus gray background; sexual attraction (desired date/kiss behavior)

n.sample_role: Analytic cases in the mutually exclusive Red and Grey groups for the named independent-samples comparison; observational unit not specified in this output.
n.exclusions: Not documented in the supplied SPSS output; these are outcome-specific cases in Group Statistics, not a recruitment total.
n.location: SPSS_output.docx, Group Statistics, sex_attraction_avg, Condition / N columns (Red and Grey)

notes:
Replication statistics are author-reported primary post-completion registration values for the supplied OSF locator, not the pooled Collabra meta-analysis. The authors give an overall failure verdict; no separate likability replication-success verdict is supplied in this registration. Original sample is stated as 33, but the printed t(32) is retained without correction. Original likability effect size and test statistic are not printed. Replication p and t are from the corresponding equal-variances-assumed SPSS test; d is the author-reported post-completion registration effect for the same outcome. The replication analytic n is printed per group, without conversion to a new statistic.
Completion source review (n_r): Outcome label directly identifies the target in the primary output at the assigned OSF locator. Group Statistics supplies N for the two mutually exclusive conditions in the independent-samples test. Exclusions and observational unit are not documented.
